purpose: Read-only candidate historical team aggregates from the audited NHL-05 as-of game view

scope.input: Synthetic offline NHL fixture archive only

temporal_rules: A statistic is eligible only when its historical source game has a known final outcome before the target cutoff.
No target-game state or result is a predictive input.
The effective availability timestamp of every included statistic is at or before the target cutoff.
Historical rest, travel, back-to-back, and home-ice values are not treated as current target-game facts.

aggregations.means: Arithmetic mean of complete historical source-game rows, rounded to six decimal places
aggregations.special_teams: Ratio of total successes to total opportunities; a zero denominator remains unavailable
aggregations.missing: Unknown and incomplete source rows are counted explicitly, never zero-imputed
aggregations.minimum_sample_interpretation: Descriptive coverage flag only; it does not approve any model or publication
aggregations.ordering: Source game IDs are sorted numerically for reproducibility, not treated as chronological recency

next_gate: Source-rights audit, season split, leakage review, model evaluation, and explicit production approval remain separate future decisions
